name: Haid 2023 PROTAC PD framework scenarios
description: Exact article/SI table replay and dynamic hook ODE endpoint overlays.

scenarios.name: Exact article/SI table anchors
scenarios.description: One-hour exact replay of all public table/source anchors carried as derived outputs.

scenarios.name: Eq. 14 hook-model 6 h to 24 h RIPK2 degradation
scenarios.description: ODE form of Eq. 14 at C = steady-state DCmax, using t1/2,P = 45 h and steady-state Table 1 hook parameters to reproduce the reported 6 h, 24 h, and steady-state Dmax endpoints.

scenarios.name: Mechanistic Eq. 8 target-engagement degradation ODE
scenarios.description: Illustrative Eq. 8 mechanistic target-engagement ODE using Supplement Table S1 Cpd I and Supplement Table S2 Ramos parameters. kcat is user-overridable because the public paper does not report a fitted kcat for this exact combination.
